baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negated comparison at word 2 joins the living at word 3 and the dead at word 5, while the final clause locates failed human hearing at the graves in word 16.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse converts the life/death contrast into unequal capacity for auditory contact: an animate recipient can enter a hearing relation, whereas loss of life and burial close that relation. The comparison is therefore functional as well as ontological.

activation_trace.role: Equality between two things supplies the operation whose negation separates the two recipient states.
Animate life supplies the open side of the contrast and its capacity to receive sound.
Loss of life and power supplies the closed side of the contrast.
Auditory perception supplies the capacity by which the unequal states are tested.
Burial gives the dead state a concrete location beyond ordinary human address.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely says that living people and corpses differ.
changed_reading.after: The life/death contrast is operationalized as unequal availability to a hearing relation, with burial marking its ordinary human limit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root for hearing occurs in both the divine causative verb at word 8 and the denied human agent noun at word 13.
baseline_models.mechanism: The doubled causative construction makes mere sound exposure too thin. The hearing inventory also includes understanding, acceptance, and compliance, so the denied power can be the power to produce effective uptake rather than the power to emit an audible message. Burial and cognitive deadness model an interior that cannot convert signal into response.

activation_trace.role: Understanding and compliance extend hearing from acoustic registration to effective uptake.
Causing another to hear matches both grammatical forms and makes produced reception the contested action.
Deadness of understanding supplies a focus-anchored functional analogue to physical death.
Concealment and enclosure make the grave a model of inaccessible interiority.

changed_reading.before: To make hear means only to deliver sound loudly enough.
changed_reading.after: To make hear can mean causing a message to become understood, accepted, and response-producing inside an otherwise closed recipient.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same causative hearing action is affirmed with divine agency at word 8 and denied to the second-person human agent at word 13; word 10 inserts selective willing between them.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse separates proclamation from control of reception. Selective willing governs whether caused hearing occurs, while the messenger's agency stops before that interior result. The contrast protects a real human communicative task without assigning the human agent power over receptivity itself.

activation_trace.role: Causing another to hear names the single action distributed asymmetrically between divine and human agency.
Volition attached to an outcome supplies the selective control between message and reception.
The concrete grave fixes an undeniable endpoint for the human agent's reach.

changed_reading.before: The second-person denial reports that the messenger's attempt has failed.
changed_reading.after: The denial defines jurisdiction: the messenger may address, but produced receptivity belongs to selective divine agency.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier context places ordinary life inside deception and depicts an actively seeing person who classifies a bad act as good. Biological life and functioning sight therefore do not guarantee truthful reception. The focus term for the living can still be literal, but its useful contrast is sharpened toward responsive, correctly oriented life rather than heartbeat alone.

activation_trace.role: Animate life anchors the reading in the focus category while leaving its quality open.
Understanding and compliance define the responsive quality that bare life may lack.
Ordinary animate life supplies a biologically live state that nevertheless occurs within a deception warning.
Deceptive appearance that gleams without stability makes life compatible with false orientation.
Applied beautification supplies the mechanism that distorts an otherwise active perception.
Actual badness supplies the object whose quality is misregistered.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies an active sensory event that can still reach a false verdict.
Goodness opposite badness supplies the mistaken classification and completes the inversion.

structural_cues: Before the focus, ordinary life is named inside a deception warning, and an intact act of seeing reverses the value of its object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: life can deceive and beautification can make bad action appear good. Reader: a live sensory subject may still be functionally non-receptive. Alternative: the focus contrast may remain only biological, with these earlier scenes supplying no lexical restriction.

changed_reading.before: The living side of the focus contrast is automatically the good and receptive side.
changed_reading.after: Biological life is not itself the valued state; the decisive life is one whose perception can become truthful and responsive.

context_deltas.mechanism: The wind-cloud-land sequence supplies a carried medium that is stirred, driven, and applied to dead ground until life appears and rising follows. Read back into the focus, caused hearing can be modeled as reanimation: a message reaches a closed substrate and becomes life-producing only through divine efficacy.

activation_trace.role: Land made alive by rain supplies a latent ecological image inside the focus term for the living.
Unproductive dead land supplies a material analogue for a recipient that cannot yet answer.
Causing another to hear is the focus action recast as the production of new responsiveness.
Moving air supplies the first carrier in the material delivery chain.
Stirring something from its place supplies activation rather than passive contact.
Driving a carrier toward a destination supplies directed transmission.
Dead land and its prior death supply the inert receiving substrate.
Earth-life through rain supplies the observable transition from inertness to response.
Revival after death names the completed transition and its eschatological reach.

structural_cues: 35:9 presents an ordered carrier-to-substrate sequence and explicitly moves from dead land through enlivening to rising.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: wind, stirring, driving, dead land, enlivening, and rising form a causal material sequence. Reader: message is analogous to the carried water and effective hearing to the land's reanimation. Alternative: the sequence may orient only bodily resurrection, without modeling communication.

changed_reading.before: Divine hearing is superior delivery of information.
changed_reading.after: Divine making-hear can be imagined as reanimating a recipient so that transmitted material becomes living response.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier unequal-seas comparison distinguishes the waters by drinkability yet immediately assigns provision from both. Repetition of the same non-equality construction therefore calibrates the focus contrast: inequality can identify a decisive affordance without erasing every capacity or value on one side. In the focus, effective hearing is the local affordance under comparison.

activation_trace.role: Equality and equivalence anchor the focus comparison that the earlier comparison calibrates.
Effective understanding supplies the particular affordance in which the focus categories differ.
The repeated equality operation links the sea pair formally to the focus pair.
Fresh sweet water supplies one side's distinctive suitability for drinking.
Intensely salty bitter water supplies the opposed drinking condition.
Total inclusion extends the next benefit across both unequal waters.
Edible provision supplies a shared output that survives the non-equality claim.

structural_cues: The earlier verse repeats the focus comparison formula, specifies one axis of difference, and then names outputs available from each side.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: two waters are unequal in a named property while both yield provision. Reader: repeated syntax makes focus non-equality similarly task-specific, centered on response-capable hearing. Alternative: the common yields may be independent of the comparison and leave the focus polarity absolute.

changed_reading.before: Not equal is a total valuation in which the dead side has no remaining significance.
changed_reading.after: Not equal can mark a decisive difference in communicative affordance without functioning as a total inventory of either side.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context explicitly separates calling, hearing, and answering: a call may fail to be heard, and hypothetical hearing may still fail to produce response. This staged pipeline strongly favors the effective-uptake baseline. The focus denial concerns control over the transition from delivered address to answer-capable reception, not merely acoustic range.

activation_trace.role: Understanding and compliance anchor the response-bearing sense of focus hearing.
Causing another to hear names control over a stage beyond simply issuing a call.
Calling by speech supplies the emitted address at the pipeline's first stage.
Auditory perception supplies a distinct middle stage that can be denied or hypothetically granted.
Answering speech supplies the final response stage that does not follow automatically from hearing.

structural_cues: 35:14 first negates hearing and then, under a contrary-to-fact hearing condition, separately negates response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: call, auditory reception, and answer are grammatically distinct stages. Reader: the relevant result of making-hear in the focus is response-capable uptake across those stages. Alternative: 35:14 may describe only the impotence of invoked beings and offer no general communication model.

changed_reading.before: A message either reaches the ear or does not.
changed_reading.after: Address, auditory registration, comprehension, and answering are separable stages; divine making-hear reaches farther along that chain than human proclamation.

context_deltas.mechanism: A heavily burdened person may call even a close relative, yet none of the burden is carried; effective warning is then restricted to those who already fear beyond sight. The social scene supplies a nontransferability mechanism: another person can call and warn, but cannot carry the recipient's interior response. This sharpens the focus agency boundary at the level of individual uptake.

activation_trace.role: Understanding and compliance anchor the interior response that cannot be transferred by another person.
A heavy burden supplies the personal load that another recipient cannot absorb.
Calling by speech supplies communicative effort without guaranteed transfer.
Bearing responsibility or load supplies the unavailable substitution between persons.
Kinship supplies the strongest social proximity and shows that proximity still cannot compel transfer.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the messenger's real but bounded intervention.
Fear with awe supplies the recipient-side disposition under which warning becomes effective.

structural_cues: One sentence moves from failed burden transfer despite kinship to a restricted class for whom warning is effective.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: calling cannot transfer a load even across kinship, while warning reaches those marked by fear. Reader: reception, like burden, is personally nondelegable. Alternative: the load scene may concern legal responsibility alone and not explain hearing.

changed_reading.before: The messenger's inability is mainly a deficit of communicative force.
changed_reading.after: The inability also protects the nontransferable interior work of reception: another can warn but cannot carry uptake for the hearer.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus is the fourth contrast in a sequence that moves through recipient faculty, perceptual medium, protective environment, and organismic state before naming hearing and agency. This makes hearing one layer in an ecology of receptivity: a capable recipient, an enabling medium, a livable condition, and enlivened responsiveness cooperate, while the messenger controls none of the whole field.

activation_trace.role: The equality comparison carries the preceding contrast pattern into the focus verse.
Animate life supplies the organismic layer in the sequence.
Loss of life supplies the opposed organismic condition.
Understanding and compliance turn the sequence from environmental contrasts to responsive reception.
The repeated comparison operation opens the immediate sequence of unequal conditions.
Loss of sight supplies an unavailable recipient faculty.
Visual perception supplies the corresponding available faculty.
Illumination supplies an enabling perceptual medium rather than a recipient organ.
Protective shade supplies a sustaining environment around the recipient.
Opposing heat supplies an environment that overwhelms rather than shelters.

structural_cues: 35:19-22 forms one chained negative comparison: faculty, medium, environment, life-state, then a shift into who can cause hearing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: four paired contrasts are contiguous and the last is followed by causative hearing. Reader: the pairs describe layers of one receptivity system. Alternative: they may be cumulative rhetorical examples with no layered causal architecture.

changed_reading.before: The focus contains an isolated metaphor comparing believers and unbelievers to living and dead.
changed_reading.after: The focus culminates a multimodal field in which faculty, medium, environment, life, and agency jointly determine whether address becomes response.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the focus, the second-person role is reduced to warning and then expanded as commissioned delivery of truth. Earlier peoples still reject after messengers, clarifications, and written material arrive. Abundant and clear transmission can therefore coexist with non-hearing, confirming that the denied human power is reception control rather than proclamation.

activation_trace.role: Causing another to hear anchors the result explicitly withheld from the messenger.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the messenger's positively retained task.
Messenger and message supply commissioned transmission rather than control of the addressee.
Truth fixed to reality supplies the sound content of the commission.
Attributing falsehood supplies an active recipient-side rejection after delivery.
Clarification by speech or sign supplies intelligible evidence that still does not compel uptake.
Organized writing supplies a durable message medium beyond transient sound.

structural_cues: The verse immediately after the focus defines the addressee as only a warner, and the next two verses contrast complete delivery with historical rejection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the messenger warns and delivers truth, while prior audiences reject multiple clear media. Reader: making-hear denotes the uncommissioned result of compelled uptake. Alternative: the role language may primarily console the messenger rather than formally partition communicative causation.

changed_reading.before: Not making the graves hear might imply that proclamation itself is ineffective or deficient.
changed_reading.after: Proclamation remains complete and accountable; what is denied is ownership of the recipient's conversion from evidence to uptake.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later context moves from reciting or following the book to inheriting it, then divides the inheritors into self-wronging, moderate, and forward responses under divine permission. The focus life/death threshold therefore need not flatten the living side. Once address is live, uptake can still produce differentiated trajectories.

activation_trace.role: Understanding and compliance anchor the response whose degrees are traced later.
Following in sequence supplies both voiced recitation and enacted continuation of the message.
Transmission of book or knowledge as inheritance supplies a shared received object.
Withholding a due right supplies the lagging trajectory within the recipient group.
Moderation between extremes supplies the middle trajectory of uptake.
Advancing ahead supplies the accelerated trajectory of responsive action.
Permission supplies the divine authorization under which the differentiated advance occurs.

structural_cues: A shared book is recited, inherited, and then followed by a three-way distribution among its recipients.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: one inherited message is followed by three recipient trajectories under permission. Reader: these are degrees within effective hearing rather than alternatives to hearing. Alternative: the categories may classify conduct after reception and say nothing about the hearing event itself.

changed_reading.before: The living/dead pair exhausts the verse's recipient taxonomy as a simple binary.
changed_reading.after: The binary can mark a threshold into receptivity while the living side retains lagging, moderate, and advancing degrees of response.

context_deltas.mechanism: The condemned are not permitted to die, yet they produce loud pleas and remember that warning came. Biological continuance, acoustic power, and memory thus coexist with a closed possibility of changed action. This later reversal prevents a flat equation of life with hearing and death with silence; focus life is most forcefully the still-open interval for response.

activation_trace.role: Loss of life anchors the literal focus pole that the later non-death scene complicates.
Auditory perception supplies the minimal acoustic sense shown to be insufficient.
Understanding and compliance supply the stronger response sense that can become temporally impossible.
Burial anchors the ordinary terminal condition against which the later scene forms a reversal.
A decisive death decree supplies the event specifically withheld from the speakers.
Actual death supplies the state they do not reach despite irreversible closure.
A loud raised voice supplies undeniable acoustic activity after the response window has closed.
A plea for rescue supplies intentional address that can no longer alter the outcome.
Remembering after prior neglect supplies cognition without recoverable compliance.
The warning that should awaken caution supplies the earlier opportunity now recalled too late.

structural_cues: 35:36-37 juxtaposes denied death, loud speech, remembered warning, and a rejected request to return and act differently.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: speakers remain biologically active, vocal, and remembering while changed action is refused. Reader: this is a counterexample to equating focus hearing with acoustics or focus life with mere continuance. Alternative: afterlife conditions may be exceptional and should not be projected back into the focus categories.

changed_reading.before: The living hear because they remain biologically alive, while the dead are silent.
changed_reading.after: Acoustic life can persist after the effective response window closes; focus life is especially the condition in which hearing can still become changed action.

context_deltas.mechanism: A community promises superior guidance if a warner comes, but the warner's arrival increases only distancing, followed by self-magnifying conduct. Exposure is therefore not a neutral near-hearing state: a recipient can actively move away under the message. Divine making-hear denotes a changed relation to address, whereas non-hearing may be resistant counter-motion rather than inert absence.

activation_trace.role: Understanding and compliance anchor hearing as a positive relation to the message.
Selective volition anchors the divine efficacy needed to reverse resistant motion.
Warning intended to awaken caution supplies the message whose arrival produces the opposite effect.
Gentle direction toward a true path supplies the response they had claimed they would achieve.
Increase supplies the explicit directional change caused in the audience after arrival.
Drawing away from something supplies active counter-reception rather than simple lack of contact.
Self-magnifying pride supplies a live mediator for the audience's movement away.

structural_cues: 35:42 states a before-and-after reversal: expected guidance, arrival of warning, then increased aversion; 35:43 continues with pride.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: arrival is followed by increased distancing and pride. Reader: this is a negative activation path within the focus hearing problem. Alternative: pride and scheming may be the real causes, with warning only exposing rather than increasing resistance.

changed_reading.before: Those not made to hear simply remain where they were because the message never reaches them.
changed_reading.after: A message can reach an audience and intensify active withdrawal; making-hear is a transformed response, not mere exposure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the straightness and completion branch of the comparison root rather than its dominant equality branch. It remains anchored in the focus form and gains coherence from beneficial life, cognitive deadness, effective hearing, and grave-like enclosure. Downstream prose should present it only as a secondary lexical resonance, not as a replacement translation of the comparison.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 2 can activate inner straightness or completion, while words 3, 5, 8/13, and 16 supply beneficial life, dead understanding, effective uptake, and enclosure.

activation_trace.role: Straightness and completion supply a latent sense of becoming internally integrated rather than merely equal.
Life as benefit supplies the functional wholeness associated with the living side.
Deadness of intelligence supplies the opposed inner disintegration.
Understanding and compliance supply the integrated response in which inner alignment becomes visible.
Concealment and enclosure supply the condition that blocks such integration from being reached.

changed_reading.before: The comparison only ranks two externally defined groups.
changed_reading.after: As a contained resonance, the verse may also contrast internally completed responsive life with enclosed and cognitively dead dis-integration.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain root activation: the later permission-form does not literally mean ear. It remains worth carrying because its inventory also contains the bodily ear and acceptance of what is heard, while the focus joins selective divine willing to caused hearing. Render it as wordplay about an authorized auditory gate, never as a lexical claim about the later occurrence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins the hearing root at words 8/13 to selective willing at word 10; the later permission root supplies an ear-shaped activation around divine authorization.

activation_trace.role: The ear and site of hearing supply the bodily gate through which the outlier imagines reception.
Selective volition supplies control over whether the imagined gate opens.
The ear branch supplies a latent bodily aperture under the permission-form occurrence.
Attending to and accepting heard material supplies the responsive state beyond the aperture.
Permission supplies the actual contextual sense and authorizes the transition without lexical conflation.

changed_reading.before: Selective hearing is an unexplained act imposed on a passive ear.
changed_reading.after: As contained wordplay, divine willing authorizes an ear-gate to become attentive acceptance rather than merely forcing sound through it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it temporalizes a concrete burial image into a historical archive and deadline. It remains anchored in the grave's burial and concealment branches, while later context asks present people to travel, inspect prior outcomes, and recognize a delayed but fixed term. Render it as a temporal-historical overlay on actual graves, not as a denial of literal burial.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The graves at word 16 mark the location beyond human caused hearing; later travel, inspection, outcomes, delay, and term make that location readable as the closed side of a historical response window.

activation_trace.role: Actual burial supplies the terminal location from which the historical overlay begins.
Concealment below the surface supplies the latent archive quality of what has become inaccessible.
Causing another to hear anchors the human action that expires at the historical boundary.
A recurring course supplies the repeatable pattern connecting current and prior audiences.
Travel through the land supplies physical access to traces left by closed audiences.
Directed sight or insight supplies the present audience's way of reading those traces.
The final outcome supplies what remains inspectable after an audience's response window closes.
Delay to a later time supplies the still-open interval before closure.
A fixed temporal limit supplies the endpoint after which warning cannot become present action.

changed_reading.before: The graves only indicate spatial distance from audible speech.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory overlay, graves also mark a temporal archive: prior audiences can be inspected but no longer moved into present response.

strongest_changes: The 35:14 call-hear-answer sequence turns focus hearing from sound exposure into response-capable uptake.
The 35:19-22 comparison chain makes the focus the organismic and auditory end of a layered receptivity field.
The 35:9 dead-land sequence activates a material model in which making-hear resembles reanimation through a carried medium.
The 35:23-25 role sequence separates complete proclamation from control of reception.
The 35:36-37 and 35:42 reversals show that audible life can be closed to change and that warning can increase active withdrawal.
summary.what_was_special: The focus did not settle into one metaphor. Repeated comparison syntax calibrated what non-equality does; ecological revival supplied a causal material analogy; nearby sensory pairs distributed receptivity across faculty, medium, environment, and life; and later scenes reversed simple equations among life, sound, and response. The result preserves literal graves, effective-hearing semantics, individual nontransferability, graded uptake, active resistance, and several contained root-level resonances at once.
remaining_uncertainties: How far the living/dead pair extends beyond physical life into cognition and response remains deliberately unresolved.
The unequal-seas comparison may qualify non-equality by affordance, or its shared yields may be structurally independent.
The immediate sensory sequence may encode a layered causal system or only cumulative rhetorical contrast.
The later non-death speakers may legitimately revise the focus's acoustic model, but afterlife conditions could be exceptional.
The ear-permission resonance and historical-grave overlay are branch-grounded but should remain explicitly exploratory.
